prose: Emily Ridout returns to InnerVerse to debut her first book, AstroYoga For An Aquarian Age, a text that will help you combine astrology and yoga to embody your unique purpose. We will dive into the theory and practice of AstroYoga, to help us enter into a deeper connection with the cosmos as template for the human form, which is the mirror to the entire universe.
ext: Our conversation takes us to mantras and the technology of language, the history of astrology, yoga, and ancient civilizations, the trinity and Linga/Yoni cults, reconciling sidereal and tropical systems, the spiral of large cycles of time, and much more.
